labels.policy: Use only source-authorized labels that help this view. Prefer short labels beside the actual object with quiet unheaded leaders, or a few discrete direct labels; choose one treatment per object. Do not repeat the same inventory on surfaces and in perimeter bullet lists. No invented applications, marketing subtitle, specifications, labels or decorative disclosure badge. Required text is exact and legible, with strong contrast against the actual surface.
labels.title: A small optional heading in negative space; the source title is available in the external caption.

palette_policy: Use restrained solid semantic accents and quiet neutral context. Equivalent objects share the same treatment; strong text contrast and source-backed grouping establish hierarchy before color.
freedom: Choose clear planar alignment, spacing and framing within the selected source scope.
Source identities, membership and selected relationships remain unchanged.

user_intent.description: Draw an English flat engineering system architecture figure titled 'Coherent Heterogeneous SoC'. This is a generic reference system, not a physical floorplan. Within one SoC boundary: a CPU Cluster contains CPU Cores and Private Cache; an NPU Cluster contains Tensor Engines and NPU Cache; Shared Resources contains Coherent Fabric and Shared LLC; Memory Interface contains DRAM Controller; Host I/O contains PCIe Endpoint. External DRAM and an External Host are outside the SoC boundary. Show only the high-level memory/request direction, not all response signals: CPU Cores → Private Cache → Coherent Fabric; Tensor Engines → NPU Cache → Coherent Fabric; Coherent Fabric → Shared LLC → DRAM Controller → External DRAM; External Host → PCIe Endpoint → Coherent Fabric. CPU and NPU caches are coherent clients; do not add bypasses, capacities, clocks, core counts, snoop routes or physical details. Draw all named modules and group ownership at a readable scale in a single figure. The reader should immediately see compute clients, shared coherence/cache, memory access, and host ingress. Generic conceptual architecture. English labels only.
user_intent.notes: Strictly flat, front-facing system illustration. White background, restrained blue compute clients and warm neutral memory. No perspective, shadows or materials. Keep the named ownership and selected request paths readable.
